topic: Google's free AI stack vs paid ChatGPT
angle: A free stack that covers most of what people pay twenty dollars for
hook: Google's free AI stack vs a paid ChatGPT plan
caption:
This is not a free-is-always-better post. Paid ChatGPT is better at some things and I will say which. But most people paying twenty dollars a month are using it for three tasks, and Google's free tier does all three. Worth ten minutes to check which group you are in.

💬 Comment "COMPARE" and I'll send you the full list.
🔖 Save this for the next time you need it.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#google #gemini #chatgpt #aitools #freetools #productivity

slides.text: Google's *free* AI stack vs a paid ChatGPT plan
slides.subline: Where free wins and where it genuinely does not

slides.text: Most people paying monthly use their AI for three things. All three have a free equivalent.

slides.left_text: Long documents, search with sources, image understanding, quick drafting.
slides.right_text: Hard reasoning, long agentic tasks, and the newest model on launch day.

slides.title: Audit your last week
slides.body: Open your chat history and read what you actually asked. Not what you imagined you would use it for. Most histories are drafting, summarising and searching.

slides.caption: cover almost every paid AI subscription in ordinary use

slides.title: Downgrade for one month
slides.body: Cancel and run free for thirty days. If you hit a wall you will know exactly which wall, and you can pay for that specific thing instead of paying by default.

slides.text: Save this before you need it
slides.subline: Send it to someone still paying for this
